sentences.en: When Sutro dedicated the statue in 1887 on Thanksgiving Day, he told the crowd,

sentences.en: May the light shine from the torch of the goddess of liberty to inspire our citizens to good and
sentences.zh: 愿自由女神火炬发出的光芒，激励我们的公民为了人类的福祉，去做出善良和

sentences.en: At that moment, it must have seemed like it would stand forever to be a timeless reminder
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，它看起来似乎会永远矗立在那里，成为一个永恒的提醒，

sentences.en: ideals.
sentences.zh: 理想。

sentences.en: By the 1940s, there was discussion about removing it because pieces had fallen off.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪40年代，由于雕像部分脱落，人们开始讨论将其拆除。

sentences.en: And after decades of neglect, sometime in the 1950s, it just disappears.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数十年的忽视后，大约在20世纪50年代，它就彻底消失了。

sentences.en: No one knows who ordered its removal or what happened to the statue.
sentences.zh: 没人知道是谁下令拆除的，也不知道雕像后来去了哪里。

sentences.en: All that is left is the stone base, a lovely landscaped knoll, and a view that sends hikers

sentences.zh: 或者也可能不需要。

sentences.zh: 但我真心热爱这个地方。

sentences.en: It's the greateSt.
sentences.zh: 它是最棒的。

sentences.en: So I would be remiss if I didn't take you to the greatest piece of infrastructure ever
sentences.zh: 所以如果我不带你们去看看有史以来最伟大的基础设施，

sentences.zh: 那就是我的失职了，那就是金门大桥。

sentences.en: So I'm looking up at the bridge from Cavallo Point, which is not actually in the city.
sentences.zh: 我现在正从卡瓦洛角仰望大桥，这里其实不在市区内。

sentences.zh: 它位于大桥的北侧。

sentences.en: But it's a great place to take in the majesty of this beautiful thing.
sentences.zh: 但这里确实是欣赏这座美丽建筑宏伟气势的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: Earlier, I mentioned that the Transamerica Pyramid works better, you know, the farther you
sentences.zh: 早些时候我提到过，泛美金字塔大厦离得越远看效果越好，

sentences.en: are away from it, and that the Salesforce Tower is better up close.
sentences.zh: 而赛富时大厦则近看更好。

sentences.en: Well, the Golden Gate Bridge is perfect from every angle and vantage point.

sentences.zh: 从东湾望去，它那纤细的轮廓优雅动人。

sentences.zh: 步行走过它也是一种享受。

sentences.en: The chief engineer in the construction of the bridge was Joseph Strauss, but a lot of the
sentences.zh: 大桥建设的总工程师是约瑟夫·斯特劳斯，但很多

sentences.en: structural design was by a fellow named Charles Alden Ellis.
sentences.zh: 结构设计是由一位名叫查尔斯·奥尔登·埃利斯的人完成的。

sentences.en: They fought a lot while the bridge was being built, with Strauss accusing Ellis of wasting
sentences.zh: 在大桥建造过程中他们经常吵架，斯特劳斯指责埃利斯浪费

sentences.en: time and money.
sentences.zh: 时间和金钱。

sentences.en: But Strauss was the boss, and he fired Ellis and ended up getting most of the credit for
sentences.zh: 但斯特劳斯是老板，他解雇了埃利斯，最终将大部分功劳

sentences.en: the bridge himself.
sentences.zh: 都归于自己名下。

sentences.en: Ellis only got recognition for his contribution decades later.
sentences.zh: 埃利斯的贡献直到几十年后才得到认可。

sentences.en: And you might think this Joseph Strauss seems like a credit-hogging, nasty piece of work.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得这个约瑟夫·斯特劳斯是个爱抢功劳、讨厌的家伙。

sentences.en: And that may be true, but there is much more to him than that.
sentences.zh: 这或许是真的，但他远不止于此。

sentences.en: But Chief Engineer Joseph Strauss was maniacally devoted to worker safety.
sentences.zh: 总工程师约瑟夫·斯特劳斯对工人的安全有着近乎狂热的执着。

sentences.en: The job of bridge men was very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 桥梁工人的工作非常危险。

sentences.en: Sixty mile-an-hour gusts of wind could come out of nowhere and sweep men into the water.
sentences.zh: 时速六十英里的阵风会毫无征兆地袭来，将人卷入水中。

sentences.en: So it made a rule that all workers had to wear clip-on safety lines.
sentences.zh: 所以他规定所有工人必须佩戴安全挂钩。

sentences.en: And a lot of the macho tough guys wouldn't wear them and complained.
sentences.zh: 很多大男子主义的硬汉不愿佩戴并抱怨连连。

sentences.en: But on the Golden Gate bridge build, if you didn't wear one, you were fired.
sentences.zh: 但在金门大桥的施工现场，如果不戴，就会被解雇。

sentences.en: And eventually, everyone fell in line.
sentences.zh: 最终，所有人都服从了规定。

sentences.en: He was also one of the first chief engineers to insist on hardhats on the job.
sentences.zh: 他也是首批坚持要求在工地上佩戴安全帽的总工程师之一。

sentences.en: But the ultimate expression of his commitment to worker safety was when he spent over $130,000
sentences.zh: 但他对工人安全承诺的终极体现，是他花费了超过13万美元，

sentences.en: on a safety net to be installed as work began on the bridge's roadbed.
sentences.zh: 在大桥路基开始施工时安装了一张安全网。

sentences.en: It was the most expensive, elaborate safety device ever conceived for a major construction site.
sentences.zh: 这是当时为大型建筑工地构思的最昂贵、最精密的防护装置。

sentences.en: The net ended up saving 19 lives.
sentences.zh: 这张网最终挽救了19条生命。

sentences.en: Nineteen men fell off the bridge during construction and fell safely into the net.
sentences.zh: 有19名工人在施工期间从桥上坠落，但都安全地落在了网里。

sentences.en: It spanned across the entire length of the bridge and stuck out about 10 feet wider than the roadbed on each side
sentences.zh: 它横跨大桥全长，并且在两侧各向外延伸了约10英尺，超出了路基范围，

sentences.en: because with those winds, people didn't just fall straight down.
sentences.zh: 因为在那种风力下，人们坠落时不会只是垂直下落。

sentences.en: They flew some distance, and the net caught them all.
sentences.zh: 他们会飞出一段距离，而网把他们全都接住了。

sentences.en: The 19 men who accidentally fell into the net called themselves the Halfway to Hell Club,
sentences.zh: 那19名意外落入网中的工人自称为“地狱半途俱乐部”，

sentences.en: which is pretty badass.
sentences.zh: 这名字听起来挺酷的。

sentences.en: The net became this real morale booster.
sentences.zh: 这张网成了真正的士气提振器。

sentences.en: Workers were kind of excited by the notion that people actually cared,
sentences.zh: 工人们因为有人真正关心他们而感到有些兴奋，

sentences.en: and the net turned out to be kind of fun,
sentences.zh: 而且这张网最终还变得挺有趣的，

sentences.zh: 甚至严重到他们不得不被下令禁止故意跳进网里。

sentences.en: There was a major accident during construction where 10 men died when a platform broke free
sentences.zh: 在施工期间曾发生过一起重大事故，一个平台脱落导致10名工人死亡

sentences.en: and crushed the bridgemen below.

sentences.zh: 但即便有这样一次偶然的事件，

sentences.zh: 金门大桥建设的安全记录远比奥克兰海湾大桥要好，

sentences.en: where 28 workers died.
sentences.zh: 那里有28名工人死亡。

sentences.zh: 金门大桥在珍视桥梁工人和钢铁工人的生命方面是一个真正的飞跃，

sentences.en: and that's what I think of when I see it now,
sentences.zh: 而这正是我现在看到它时所想到的，

sentences.zh: 那座最伟大的由人建造的结构是以有人性化的方式建造的。

sentences.en: The Mighty Task is Done.
